title: Q2 Hosted API Lineup Gap Analysis and Canary Playbook
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Objective: Produce a prioritized Q2 plan that trims redundant hosted API model variants, closes capability gaps for high-traffic routes, and prescribes canary windows and rollback criteria for model rotations. Scope: analysis covers top 50 hosted routes by token volume, 3 quantization/precision tiers (fp16, int8, int4), and retention of one fallback per route. Deliverables: 1) Gap matrix (capability, latency, cost) per route; 2) Recommended lineup with deprecation dates; 3) Canary playbook (traffic split, metrics, SLOs, regression thresholds); 4) Rollout runbook with prerequisite infra/console changes. Acceptance criteria: gap matrix validated by infra and applied ML owners; recommended lineup reduces projected token cost by >=8% for targeted routes without increasing 95th percentile latency by >10ms; canary plan includes automated abort rules and observability dashboard links. Out of scope: on-prem private deployment config changes and contractual pricing for Dedicated customers.
